law: The class provides a default implementation of a Metal-aware view that you can use to render graphics using Metal and display them onscreen.
The view requires a object to manage the Metal objects it creates for you.
You must set the property and, optionally, modify the view’s drawable properties before drawing.
Use this mode for games and other animated content that’s regularly updated.
Use this mode for apps with a more traditional workflow, where updates happen when data changes, but not on a regular timed interval.
Use this mode to create your own custom workflow.
You should either subclass or provide a delegate, but not both.
After rendering the contents, you must present the drawable to update the view’s contents.
Don’t wait for the command buffer to finish executing before registering the drawable’s presentation.
Use a delegate to provide a drawing method to a object and respond to rendering events without subclassing the class.
